description: On a phone, the new-conversation composer labels the model and directory fields a row each. The screen is {{W}}x915. To "open the model picker": wait for ".header" to be visible; when the window is narrower than 768px, the picker is in the overflow menu: if ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, click the button with aria-label exactly "More options", then click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".chat-overflow-popover"; on a wider window, click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".status-bar". The element clicked is "the picker"; its panel is ".model-picker-panel". Accessible names: an element's name is its aria-label if it has one; otherwise a button's name is its text with whitespace collapsed and trimmed, leaving out aria-hidden parts, and a dialog's name is the text of the element its aria-labelledby refers to; "named X" means the name is exactly X. Only elements that are not display: none count. Names used below: "the composer" is ".status-bar-new"; "the labels" are its ".status-field-label" elements; "the model field" is ".status-field-model .model-picker.p-select"; "the directory field" is ".status-field-cwd .status-chip". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. The labels' texts should be exactly ["Model:", "Dir:"]. 3. Eval window.__fieldRows() (the page already defines it; do not define it yourself): it checks at once that the rows (first label with the model field, last label with the directory field) are stacked, inside the viewport, with the labels right-aligned in a column of their own and the fields boxed in one after it, and returns the list of what fails; it must return exactly []. 4. The model field's ".model-picker-value-name" text must not be empty, and its ".p-select-dropdown" should be visible. The composer must have no button whose accessible name starts with "Profile" (count 0). 5. Keyboard focus shows on the model's box: focus the directory field (eval .focus()), remember the model field's computed border-top-color in a window variable, then press Shift+Tab; the model field's element with role="combobox" must then be document.activeElement, and the model field's border-top-color must differ from the remembered one. 6. Click the model field: the panel should be visible and contain an element with data-testid "model-picker-profiles" (attached, visible or not). Click the panel's button with aria-label "Close": the panel should be hidden. 7. Click the directory field: ".modal.directory-picker-modal" should be visible; click its button named exactly "Cancel": it should be hidden. 8. Open the model picker (through the overflow menu, since the window is narrower than 768px): the picker should have the class "model-picker-menu", and the panel should be visible. Click the panel's button with aria-label "Close". 9. In ".chat-overflow-popover", a button whose accessible name starts with "Directory" should be visible, and there must be no button whose accessible name starts with "Profile" (count 0).

steps.expression: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.status-bar-new button')).filter(b => { const name = b.getAttribute('aria-label') || b.textContent.replace(/[\s]+/g,' ').trim(); return name.startsWith('Profile'); }).length
